name: Jamie AI
summary: Offers highly accurate transcription services, suitable for various applications requiring precise speech-to-text conversion.
description:
Offers highly accurate transcription services, suitable for various applications requiring precise speech-to-text conversion.

The meeting intelligence platform you can trust. Jamie turns every meeting into knowledge you can act on, with no bot on the call, data hosted in the EU, ISO 27001 and GDPR.

AI audio processing: Jamie AI supports automated audio analysis and enhancements. Transcription support: Provides tools for converting speech to text. Noise reduction: Reduces unwanted sounds from audio input. Voice synthesis: Can generate or clone voices using AI models.
